note: City of Sutton RV park in the industrial and RV park just north of the City Park; check in and pay at City Hall for a camping permit (after hours, the police department). Sites A, B and C have electric and water only (20/30-amp). Dumpster on site; restrooms at the nearby park. 24-ft rigs reported fitting. --Claude
summary: The city's own page (Last-Modified March 2026) gives 17 sites: A-C electric/water $10, 1-14 full hookups 20/30/50 A $20 a night or $600 a month. Fees added (none stored): 10-20. Hookups and count confirmed. The stored note's $10 / $300 / $5 prices were stale and are dropped. Website should be the city page, not VisitNebraska. Pin OK. Not waterfront stands.
flags: WEBSITE: stored https://visitnebraska.com/sutton/sutton-rv-park-and-campground is a tourism listing (and 403s to plain HTTP); the operator's page is https://cityofsutton.org/businesslisting.html (section 'Parks, Ponds, & RV Camping'). Suggest replacing it.
PHONE OK: 402-773-4225 is City Hall ('Office: (402) 773-4225', where campers check in).
RATE CHANGE: the stored note had sites 1-14 at '$10/night or $300/mo' and A-C at '$5/night'; the city page now says $20 / $600 a month and $10. Note rewritten.
LONG-STAY (local, informational): monthly camping is allowed on the 14 full-hookup sites ($600/month); nightly is posted for all 17. Not a criteria problem for a city park.
PIN OK: stored 40.61375,-97.85531 is on the access road beside the angled pull-through row (row centre ~40.6139,-97.8549, ~45 m).
WATERFRONT not waterfront stands: a narrow creek channel (School Creek, a few metres wide) runs ~60-80 m west of the pad row, with the park road and a grassy swale between; no lake or river.
